key_insight: A shared framework adapts Cosmos world foundation models to stream visual observations in response to actions and scene controls for interactive Physical AI simulation.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports virtual environments for embodied-agent training and evaluation through action-conditioned prediction or visualization of externally simulated physical states.
method: Adapt Cosmos world foundation models for real-time interactive simulation.
Stream visual observations conditioned on actions and scene controls.
Support action-driven visual prediction and observation generation from external simulator states.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports demonstrations in camera navigation, robot manipulation, controllable video transfer, and multi-view autonomous vehicle simulation, but provides no quantitative evaluation results.
watch_item: Real-time latency and physical fidelity should be validated before relying on generated observations for training or evaluation.
paper_title: Interactive World Simulation with Cosmos for Physical AI
